title: 第157章 三体巫师第156章 挂不住脸的噬能虫
slug: 巫师让你学知识你杀穿万界
lines: 左边那颗是蛇头。
蛇头通体覆盖着细密的暗绿色鳞片，鳞片边缘泛着淡金色的光泽。
蛇眼的竖瞳呈琥珀色，瞳孔深处有细密的符文纹路在缓慢旋转。
蛇头微微昂起，分叉的信子从嘴角探出来，在空气中轻轻颤动。
右边那颗是蛟头。
蛟头比蛇头大了一圈，深蓝色的鳞片上流转着水波状的纹路。
蛟眼呈深蓝色，瞳孔是水平的椭圆形。蛟头的嘴角有两根细长的须子，须子末端垂在桌面上，随着呼吸轻轻摆动。
正中间那颗是龙头。
龙头比另外两颗头加起来还大。
暗金色的鳞片从额头一直覆盖到后颈，每一片鳞甲都有巴掌大小，表面刻满了繁复的符文纹路。
龙角从额头两侧斜向上延伸，角身呈深褐色，表面有螺旋状的纹路。
龙眼是竖瞳，瞳孔呈暗金色，瞳孔深处有两团淡金色的光点在缓慢燃烧。
三颗头同时抬起，六只眼睛同时落在一虫一人身上。
噬能虫从伊森头顶飞起来，六只翅膀高速振动，朝石桌飞过去。
“三体老东西，好久不见啊！”
三颗头里的蛇头先开口了。
它的清秀，就是调子拖得很长，“死虫子，你还敢来？”
蛟头跟着开口，声音低沉浑厚，带着一股水汽氤氲的潮湿感，“上次欠的债还没还清。”
龙头最后开口，声音威严沉稳，每个字都震得空气嗡嗡作响，“狗东西，还钱。”
话音还没落，三颗头的脖子同时伸长。
蛇头的脖颈拉成一道暗绿色的残影，从左侧绕过去，缠住噬能虫的左翼。
蛟头的脖颈从右侧包抄，缠住噬能虫的右翼。
龙头的脖颈从正上方压下，一口咬住噬能虫的脑袋。
三道脖颈如同三条活物的触须，将噬能虫牢牢困在半空中。
蛇头的鳞片在噬能虫的甲壳上摩擦，发出细碎的沙沙声。
蛟头的须子缠住噬能虫的两条后腿，勒得它的甲壳发出不堪重负的嘎吱声。
龙头的牙齿咬住噬能虫的头壳，上下颌微微用力，噬能虫的复眼顿时凸了出来。
“疼疼疼疼疼！”噬能虫六条腿在空中乱划，翅膀拼命振动，甲壳表面的银色符文疯狂闪烁，“老东西你轻点！我这次是带生意来的！生意！”
龙头松开了嘴。
“生意？”
蛇头和蛟头也松开了缠绕，三颗头同时缩回去，重新回到躯干正上方。
六只眼睛盯着被松开后悬在半空中喘气的噬能虫。
噬能虫活动了一下被勒得生疼的关节，六条腿在空中划拉了几下。
它飞回伊森头顶，窝在头发里，只探出半个身子。
“对，生意。这小子要找你做巫器，主材都带来了。”噬能虫用一条前肢敲了敲伊森的脑门，“世界树的树芯。怎么样，够不够格？”
三颗头的六只眼睛同时转向伊森。
伊森感觉到六道目光落在自己身上。
蛇头的目光阴冷，像是在审视一件有意思的标本。
蛟头的目光温和一些，但同样带着审视的意味。
龙头的目光最重，压得他肩膀微微往下一沉。
龙头开口了。
“三等学徒？哪个学院的？没见过。”
他的目光在伊森身上扫了一圈，从头顶到脚尖，再从脚尖回到头顶。
content_en:
The one on the left is a snake head.
The snake head is covered with fine dark green scales, and the edges of the scales have a light golden sheen.
The vertical pupils of the snake eyes are amber, and there are fine rune patterns slowly rotating deep in the pupils.
The snake's head was slightly raised, and the forked letter protruded from the corner of its mouth, trembling slightly in the air.
The one on the right is the dragon head.
The dragon's head is slightly larger than the snake's head, and its dark blue scales have water-like lines flowing on them.
The dragon's eyes are dark blue and the pupils are horizontal oval. There are two slender whiskers at the corners of the dragon's head. The ends of the whiskers hang down on the table, swaying gently with breathing.
The one in the middle is the dragon head.
The dragon's head is larger than the other two heads combined.
The dark golden scales cover from the forehead to the back of the neck. Each scale is the size of a palm, and the surface is engraved with complex rune patterns.
The dragon horns extend diagonally upward from both sides of the forehead. The body of the horn is dark brown and has spiral patterns on its surface.
The dragon's eye has a vertical pupil, the pupil is dark golden, and there are two pale golden light spots burning slowly deep in the pupil.
Three heads raised at the same time, and six eyes fell on one insect and one person at the same time.
The energy-devouring insect flew up from above Ethan's head, its six wings vibrating at high speed, and flew towards the stone table.
"Three-body old guy, long time no see!"
The snake head among the three heads spoke first.
What makes it so elegant is that the tune is very long, "Damn bug, you still dare to come?"
Jiao Tou then spoke, his voice deep and rich, with a sense of moisture and moisture, "The debt I owed last time has not been paid off yet."
Longtou finally spoke, his voice majestic and steady, and the air buzzed with every word, "You bitch, pay me back."
Before he finished speaking, the necks of the three heads stretched out at the same time.
The snake head's neck stretched into a dark green afterimage, going around from the left side and wrapping around the energy-devouring insect's left wing.
The neck of the dragon head surrounded it from the right side and entangled the energy-devouring insect's right wing.
The dragon's neck pressed down from directly above and bit the energy-devouring insect's head.
The three necks are like the tentacles of three living creatures, firmly trapping the energy-devouring insect in mid-air.
The scales of the snake head rubbed against the carapace of the energy-devouring insect, making a fine rustling sound.
The beards of the dragon's head entangled the two hind legs of the energy-devouring insect, causing its carapace to make an unbearable crunching sound.
The teeth of the dragon head bit the head shell of the energy-devouring insect. The upper and lower jaws exerted slight force, and the compound eyes of the energy-devouring insect suddenly protruded.
"It hurts, it hurts, it hurts!" The energy-devouring insect's six legs were slicing in the air, its wings were vibrating desperately, and the silver runes on the surface of the carapace were flashing crazily. "Old man, please be gentle! I'm here to bring business this time! Business!"
The dragon head opened his mouth.
"Business?"
The snake head and the dragon head were also loosened, and the three heads retracted at the same time, returning to directly above the torso.
Six eyes stared at the energy-devouring insect that was hanging in mid-air after being released, panting.
The energy-devouring insect moved its painful joints and pulled its six legs in the air a few times.
It flew back to Ethan's head and nestled in his hair, only half of his body sticking out.
"Yes, business. This guy wants to make a witchcraft weapon from you, and he has brought all the main materials." The energy-devouring insect tapped Ethan's forehead with one of its forelimbs, "The core of the World Tree. How is it, is it good enough?"
The six eyes of the three heads turned to Ethan at the same time.
Ethan felt six eyes falling on him.
The snake head's eyes were cold, as if he was examining an interesting specimen.
Jiao Tou's gaze was gentler, but still full of scrutiny.
The dragon's gaze was the most serious, causing his shoulders to sink slightly.
The leader spoke.
"Third-class apprentice? From which academy? I've never seen him."
His eyes swept around Ethan's body, from the top of his head to the tips of his toes, and then back to the top of his head.
